title: Bring Me To Life
lyrics:
[00:10.32]How can you see into my eyes
[00:16.45]Like open doors?
[00:20.55]Leading you down into my core
[00:26.53]Where I've become so numb
[00:31.52]Without a soul (Without)
[00:36.61]My spirit's sleeping somewhere cold
[00:41.73]Until you find it there and lead
[00:47.03]It back home
[00:52.16]Wake me up
[00:53.23]Wake me up inside
[00:54.49]I can't wake up
[00:55.80]Wake me up inside
[00:56.97]Save me
[00:58.29]Call my name and save me from the dark
[01:02.29]Wake me up
[01:03.36]Bid my blood to run
[01:04.64]I can't wake up
[01:05.71]Before I come undone
[01:07.13]Save me
[01:08.29]Save me from the nothing I've become
[01:14.81]Now that I know what I'm without
[01:20.78]You can't just leave me (No)
[01:24.02]Breathe into me and make me real
[01:31.23]Bring me to life (Bring me)
[01:37.62]Wake me up

[01:39.99]I can't wake up
[01:41.25]Wake me up inside
[01:42.47]Save me

[01:47.75]Wake me up

[01:51.19]Before I come undone
[01:52.60]Save me
[01:53.74]Save me from the nothing I've become
[01:59.15]Bring me to life
[02:03.83]I've been living a lie
[02:06.19]There's nothing inside
[02:09.11]Bring me to life
[02:17.84]Frozen inside, without your touch (Frozen inside, with)
[02:23.11]Without your love (Out your love)
[02:26.60]Darling
[02:27.79]Only you are the life among the dead (Only you are the life)
[02:38.26]All of this time
[02:39.42]I can't believe I couldn't see
[02:40.95]Kept in the dark
[02:41.90]But you were there in front of me
[02:43.45]I've been sleeping a thousand years, it seems
[02:46.01]Got to open my eyes to everything
[02:48.50]Without a thought, without a voice, without a soul
[02:51.06]Don't let me die here
